kyb.title: Business verification (KYC)
kyb.subtitle: Verify your registered business to sell on zaokaiy. We check your registration, owners and payout account — your documents are encrypted and only seen by our compliance team.
kyb.privacy: ID numbers are encrypted; after saving only the last 4 characters are shown.
kyb.submitted: Submitted — we'll review your business within 1–2 working days.
kyb.declaration: I confirm the information and documents are true and complete, and I'm authorised to act for this business.

badge.tooltip: zaokaiy checked this shop's business registration, owners and bank account.

entity.label: Seller type
entity.hint: Registered businesses verify their company (KYC) before publishing and get a “Verified business” badge.
entity.openHint: Company or enterprise with a registration certificate — you'll verify it (KYC) before selling.

individual.title: This shop is set up for an individual seller
individual.text: Business verification is for registered companies and enterprises. Switch if you sell as a business: you'll add your registration, owners and bank account, and get a “Verified business” badge once approved.
individual.switch: My shop is a registered business

banner.submitted: Your verification is in review. You can't edit it until we decide — we'll let you know here.
banner.gate: Until your business is verified you can create products as drafts, but not publish them.

gate.form: Your business must be verified before this product can go live. You can save it as a draft.

company.title: Company details
company.activityPh: e.g. Retail of cars and motorbikes

companyType.foreign_branch: Branch / representative office of a foreign company

people.title: Representative, directors & owners
people.hint: Add the legal representative (the person who signs for the business) and its directors.
people.hintShareholders: Add the legal representative, the directors, and every beneficial owner who holds 25% or more of the shares.
people.pepHint: Tick if this person holds, or held in the last year, a senior public position (or is a close family member of someone who does).

bank.title: Payout bank account
bank.hint: Where zaokaiy and couriers send your money (COD remittances, commissions).
bank.nameMatch: The account must be in the company's registered name.

docs.title: Documents
docs.hint: Clear photos or scans (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to {mb} MB each). All four corners visible, no glare.
docs.tooBig: The file is larger than {mb} MB.

docHint.registration_certificate: Issued by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce (or your country's company registry).
docHint.business_license: Required for regulated trades, e.g. vehicle dealers, food, pharmacy.
docHint.representative_id: Front and back of the ID card, or the passport photo page.
docHint.authorization_letter: Needed when the legal representative is not a director: signed and stamped by a director.
docHint.shareholder_register: Current list of shareholders and their percentages.
docHint.proof_of_address: Utility bill, lease or official letter showing the business address, less than 3 months old.
docHint.bank_proof: Bank statement or account book page showing the account name and number.
docHint.other: Anything else that helps us verify your business.

missing.ownership_total: Ownership adds up to more than 100%

flag.duplicate_registration: Registration number used by another account

admin.title: Business verification
admin.subtitle: Review company registrations, owners and payout accounts of business shops.
admin.reveal: Show full ID and account numbers
admin.incomplete: {n} required item(s) missing — request changes rather than approve.
admin.nameMismatch: Account name doesn't seem to match the registered name.
admin.docReason: Why is it rejected? (shown to the seller)
admin.notePh: Note to the seller (required to request changes, reject or revoke)
admin.notSubmitted: Decisions are possible once the seller submits.
admin.decisionHint: Document decisions above are saved with your decision. Every view and decision is logged.

done.revoke: Verification revoked; the shop's products are off sale.
